title: PyLearn ALP Activity Export v2
description: Learner activity PyLearn emits with `export:activity` for one platform user since a cursor, read by `alp platform import --adapter pylearn` (ADR-0059). Activity is grouped by Learning Target (`targets` replaces the v1 `courses`). Every record names a declared-stable item and an event identity; PyLearn holds only latest-state rows, so identities are Synthetic Event Identities: `event.id` is the row key and `event.revision` a content hash of the record's evidence-relevant fields. Timestamps are never part of an identity. v1 exports are not accepted.

instance.description: Opaque identifier of the PyLearn deployment the activity comes from.

id.description: Opaque PyLearn user ID. Names, emails and other user metadata are never exported; ALP resolves the learner only through a Platform Account Link.

since.description: The cursor this export continues from; null for a full snapshot.

next.description: Opaque cursor to export since next time.

id.description: Learning Target ID, as in the curriculum export.
Event identity. Synthetic: `<table>:<row key>`, stable for the row's lifetime.

revision.description: Synthetic: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of the record's evidence-relevant fields. Unchanged rows keep their revision; changed rows get a new one.

item.description: Declared-stable item ID from the curriculum export.

observedAt.description: When the row last changed; orders revisions, never identifies them.
